name: pushery/webhooks-for-laravel
description: An all-in-one, config-gated webhooks toolkit for Laravel: send signed outbound webhooks (Standard Webhooks signatures by default, Ed25519 optional), receive and verify inbound ones, let customers self-serve their endpoints, and observe every delivery on a dashboard — switch on only the layers you need.

suggest.laravel/ai: Required only to score evals with a real judge. Not a dev dependency: it requires aws/aws-sdk-php for a provider this package never calls, which is 67 MB and 3512 files in every checkout and every CI lane.
suggest.laravel/pulse: Enables the opt-in internal-ops delivery monitor (Pushery\Webhooks\Pulse\WebhookPulseServiceProvider) — a Pulse recorder and card for throughput, failure rate and latency.
suggest.laravel/scout: Enables the opt-in searchable delivery and inbound-call logs (use the ready-made Pushery\Webhooks\Search\SearchableWebhookDelivery / SearchableWebhookCall models — or apply the Pushery\Webhooks\Search\SearchableDelivery / SearchableCall traits to your own — and set webhooks.search.enabled).
suggest.livewire/livewire: Required to render any UI this package ships: the observability dashboard, the self-service endpoint portal, and the optional management components (Pushery\Webhooks\WebhooksUiServiceProvider).
suggest.pushery/wirekit: Required to render the dashboard and the self-service portal AS SHIPPED — their views are built from WireKit components. A host on another UI kit must publish the views (--tag=webhooks-dashboard-views / --tag=webhooks-self-service-views) and restyle them instead.
suggest.blade-ui-kit/blade-icons: Renders the icons the shipped screens ask WireKit for (empty states, primary actions), together with the icon set your WireKit preset resolves them into: blade-ui-kit/blade-heroicons for the default preset (`composer require blade-ui-kit/blade-icons blade-ui-kit/blade-heroicons`), or the set of the preset you configured. Without them the screens draw WireKit's inert placeholder where an icon belongs; they render either way. `webhooks:preflight` names what is missing.
suggest.blade-ui-kit/blade-heroicons: The icon set of WireKit's default preset, which the shipped screens are drawn against unless you configured another one. On a lucide, phosphor or tabler preset, install that preset's set instead; this one is then not needed.
suggest.spatie/laravel-health: Runs `Pushery\Webhooks\Health\DeliveryEngineCheck`, a health check over the delivery log: it fails above a failure rate and warns while an endpoint is switched off.
suggest.symfony/yaml: Enables `--format=yaml` on `webhooks:asyncapi`. The command defaults to JSON and reports a clear error when this package is absent, so it stays entirely optional.
